corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row67 explicitly says Don't; preserve AVOID and opportunities for user choice.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row71 lead explicitly says Consider; retain MAY while the narrower feedback-based recommendation avoidance remains0054.

statement.en: Choose or apply feedback to update predictions on a cadence that matches the person’s mental model of the feature in the documented context.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row75 contrasts update cadences; do not make real-time updates universal.

statement.en: Apply the documented Machine learning guidance to be prepared for changes in implicit feedback when you make changes to your app’s UI.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row77 explicitly covers UI-induced behavior changes; replace generic cross-reference with actionable wording.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row86 focuses on informed participation before a calibration-dependent feature; retain SHOULD.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row90 explicitly provides an object-based exception, previously missing; the baseball-field example is not a blanket one-time requirement.

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row104 supports immediate confirmation and transition, not a generic review placeholder.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row106 explicitly says Make sure about cancellation. Preserve MUST and the nonjudgmental/no-message context.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row108 supports information control and edits outside the flow; preserve SHOULD without the old unsupported when-practical qualification.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row137, Mistakes: preserve SHOULD and the proactive/unrequested context; perceived loss of user control supports priority3.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row143, Corrections: direct action and natural Japanese replace boilerplate; preserve the optional steps/controls example.

statement.en: Make immediate value when people make a correction available when applicable.

conditions: Applies when people correct a result, especially for critical features or responses to direct input.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row145, Corrections: repair the malformed make-value-available statement; especially emphasizes these cases without limiting the guidance to them.

statement.en: Preserve people’s ability to correct their corrections.
statement.ja: 利用者がcorrect their correctionsできる状態を保つ。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row147, Corrections: retain SHOULD for the ability to revise corrections; immediate response and persistence remain represented in0067.

statement.en: Balance the benefits of a feature with the effort required to make a correction in every applicable case.
statement.ja: 該当するすべての場合にbalance the benefits of a feature with the effort required to make a correctionを実行する。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row149, Corrections: explicit Always supports existing MUST; retain the tradeoff rather than inventing a numerical correction-effort threshold.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row151, Corrections: explicit Never supports existing MUST_NOT; repair malformed EN and weak Japanese without changing the prohibition.

statement.en: Favor diverse options when the documented conditions apply.

conditions: When possible, balance response accuracy with diversity so people can choose an option they prefer.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row166, Multiple options: preserve preference, when-possible balance, and user choice; no universal mandate to offer multiple results.

statement.en: Apply the documented Machine learning guidance to make options easy to distinguish and choose.

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row172, Multiple options: restore similar-option and too-many-option branches; grouping remains optional and user selection supports priority3.

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row189, Confidence: retain MAY and restore the meaningful-impact condition; the Photos example is not mandatory for every model.

statement.en: Evaluate whether using attributions to help people distinguish among results is appropriate for the current context.

conditions: Attribution can identify the premise behind an option without explaining exactly how the model works.

statement.en: Exclude being too specific or too general from the applicable experience.

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

statement.ja: 結果の根拠説明が、細かすぎたり大まかすぎたりすることは避ける。

conditions: Overly specific explanations can add interpretation work or feel intrusive; overly general ones can be unhelpful or impersonal.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row206, Attribution: limit the avoidance to attributions, not every app detail; perceived intrusive observation supports privacy priority3.

statement.en: Maintain attributions factual and based on objective analysis.
statement.ja: attributions factual and based on objective analysisを維持する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

statement.en: Keep attributions factual and grounded in objective analysis.

conditions: The explanation should help people reason about a result rather than provoke an emotional response.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row208, Attribution: repair malformed EN/JA while preserving SHOULD; the distinct personal-judgment avoidance remains in0078.

statement.ja: 「Machine learning」において「Help people establish realistic expectations」の指針を適用する。

conditions: Consider advance disclosure when a rare limitation can seriously affect the experience.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row233, Limitations: retain MAY and the resolved-limitation context; no particular notification channel or mandatory announcement is implied.
